priya: heads-up — PR #18233 (query-cache: avoid stale keys) needs to land before nightly db blackout (02:00 UTC). mac-integration still failing, run queue is long. can someone take a quick review or suggest a fast path? @release-engineering
josh: can we split the small fix (lines 1-40) into a hotfix PR and leave the refactor in the larger one? that'll speed CI.
priya: yes, split makes sense. hotfix is only cache key check + test. i'll open a new PR in ~10m and link here.
maya: i can take the quick review once it's up. ping me.
kirill: if we split, also run only the cache unit tests to get green -> ./scripts/ci/run_tests.sh --suite=cache_unit
priya: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/18290 (hotfix).
maya: looking... quick comment: need an extra null check, pushing suggestion.
maya: left a small fix, tests locally: PASS.
ci-bot: build started for PR #18290 — linux/unit, mac/integration queued.
priya: thx @maya. @release-engineering can we get a manual canary + expedited merge once mac/integration passes? :pray: 
release-engineering: we'll prioritize the canary lane if it finishes before 01:45 UTC. @ci-bot re-run mac/integration when linux/unit is green.
ci-bot: re-run requested by release-engineering for PR #18290 mac/integration.
ci-bot: mac/integration: flaky-gpu-setup failed, re-running. (retry 1)
ci-bot: mac/integration: PASSED
priya: merging now. tag: release/urgent-hotfix
josh: :rocket: landed. good work, team.
maya: will watch prod metrics for 30m.
priya: will follow up in #incidents if anything odd. thanks all!
